user.title: EO-Lite
user.description:
An overall Allow charging, an Only during timers that means it, and a Charger dashboard with the charger's timers, for an OpenEO charger that's already in Home Assistant.

The two toggles start as the charger is now, so setting this up changes nothing by itself.

data_description.charger: The charger whose charging and timers switches EO-Lite sets.
data_description.dashboard: Add EO-Lite's Charger dashboard to the sidebar the next time an admin opens Home Assistant (once: if you delete it, it stays deleted).

abort.no_charger: No charger found. Set up the OpenEO charger's own integration first: EO-Lite looks for its charging and timers switches.

create_entry.default: Reload the browser: EO-Lite then adds its Charger dashboard to the sidebar (unless you turned that off).
